purpose: Prepared-data computational extension. No claim of independent source reconstruction, natural prevalence, prospective prediction or external validation.
split: 50/25/25 stratified; exact identical predictor rows removed after excluding conflicting-label groups, as in original primary protocol
runtime: Concurrent dataset jobs; timing is diagnostic, not speedup evidence.
positive: Encoded 1 except climate outcome=0; never flip classes solely to make positives rare.
preprocessing: No new sampling; train-only median/most-frequent imputation, numeric scaling for LR, unknown-ignore one-hot for strings; prepared upstream scaling/selection may predate split.
